fact: In April-May 2026 the World Bank mission recorded that KNBS is strengthening the Statistical Business Register using administrative data under a data-sharing agreement with KRA awaiting Attorney General approval, that Annual Vital Statistics Report data collection was completed in April 2026, and that an MoU between the Civil Registration Service and KNBS on the report was expected by June 2026.
title: Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results: Implementation Support Mission, April 27 - May 7, 2026
